name: Katrina
source:
This sneaky lady is Katrina, she is Kalian's familiar. Her job is to keep an eye on everything that happens in the Field Unity and report to her master. She is very perceptive and is always ready to help when there is a problem.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/LiryaRhys/status/1491761150626783240]Twitter[/url]]
